summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved card lists not persisting  **I did a read-only audit first (no edits made).** Summary of what I found, then the plan.  ### What the code audit shows The watchlist auth/persistence chain looks correct as written: - `WatchlistPage.tsx` has no localStorage/anonymous fallback — every read/write goes through `api.*` calls with `credentials: "include"`. - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` wraps **all** routes (GET/POST/DELETE) in session middleware that 401s on missing/invalid session and injects `X-User-Id` from a validated session lookup — not client-supplied. - Eve
